Every answer was one of: the JSON 404 no-store from the Worker (/assets/../index.html, /assets/..%2findex.html and %2F, /assets/x/..%2f<file>, /assets/%5c..%5cindex.html, /assets/..%5c<file>, another case of a file or of /assets/, /assets/%252e%252e/<file>, /assets/, /assets, /favicon.svg/, /favicon.svg%2f, /..;/, /_headers, /assets/../_headers, /assets/..%2f_headers, /explore/, /%65xplore, /Explore, /explore%2f, /index.html); a file of the build by SHA-256 (/assets/%2e%2e/assets/<file>, /assets/./<file>, /assets/%2e/<file>, /assets/x/../<file>: theme-D3RbAjXO.js, immutable); a 307 whose Location is a file of the build (/assets//<file> and /assets/<name>%2ejs, both with the immutable Cache-Control; //assets/<file> with no Cache-Control); the API 401 (/assets/../api/v1/query, /assets/%2e%2e/api/v1/query: route query); the document with its policy only where the URL parser makes the path a document path (/.., /./, /%2e/, /assets/.., /favicon.svg/.., /explore/.., /api/v1/../../explore, /api/v1/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/explore, /assets/../dashboards), as deploy/README.md documents (review of D74, n-2); and Cloudflare edge 400 HTML (server cloudflare, cf-ray -, before any routing) for paths that climb above the root (/assets/../../etc/passwd, /assets/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/etc/passwd) and for %00. Never the document at a path that is not a document path, never a file outside the build, never a redirect off the origin.

10.what: the response headers of a 304 from Cloudflare for an asset and for the document through the edge's compression
10.note: Against s16-r1. With Accept-Encoding gzip, deflate, br: /assets/index-dLTlkQ5n.js, /assets/index-D7ZsqCRP.css, /favicon.svg, / and /explore came back br-compressed with a WEAK tag (W/"04eaedb1...", and for the documents W/"bece61da78b441648ef5837f091e58d3"). If-None-Match with the weak tag: 304 for each, with the STRONG tag in the 304. Asset 304 headers: Content-Type (text/javascript, text/css, image/svg+xml), Cache-Control public, max-age=31536000, immutable (favicon public, max-age=86400), ETag, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff. Document 304 headers (/ and /explore, from the Worker, x-viz-route app): Content-Type text/html, Cache-Control no-cache, ETag, the full Content-Security-Policy, Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy same-origin, Referrer-Policy no-referrer, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY. With Accept-Encoding identity: strong tags, and 304s with the same headers.
